name: KeepSecret
blurb: Password manager for viewing, editing, creating, or deleting passwords, suitable for both desktop and mobile platforms.
description:
Password manager for viewing, editing, creating, or deleting passwords, suitable for both desktop and mobile platforms.

Works with KeepassXC, KWallet, Gnome Keyring, oo7, and any other password backend that's compatible with the Secret Service system.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
